description: Land Acquisition - Amendment to the Ex. Gaz. No. 2160/9 of 27.01.2020 - Amendment to the Ex. Gaz. No. 2178/3 of 01.06.2020
categorisation: This gazette content contains multiple notices specifically related to land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act (Chapter 460). The notices amend inquiry dates and document submission deadlines for land acquisition proceedings, which falls under "land acquisitions" in the Land Gazettes category. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" and deals exclusively with land-related administrative matters, making it a clear Type 4 classification.
